description: A script that checks the local environment for software versions and system requirements, including Docker, Python, Node.js, npm, and system memory, providing status reports and validation.

classes.name: Requirement
classes.description: A class representing a software requirement, including version range checks and status reporting.

methods.name: Requirement.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Requirement object with name, version ranges, type, command, and optional post-processing.

methods.name: Requirement.get_version
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve the current version of the requirement.

methods.name: Requirement.check_version
methods.description: Checks if the current version is ideal, supported, or unsupported.

methods.name: Requirement.format_result
methods.description: Formats the requirement status and version info into a string for display.

methods.name: check_memory
methods.description: Checks if system memory meets the minimum GB requirement.

methods.name: get_cpu_info
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core count and frequency information.

methods.name: get_docker_platform
methods.description: Detects Docker platform information or reports if not detected.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that performs environment checks based on command-line options, outputs system info and software status.
